title: As Fast as She Can
cn: 第 23 集 · 越快越好
novel:
Ted [[ran|run]] into Tony at a restaurant. Tony was Stella's ex — the man she left Ted for. The [[encounter|encounter]] was [[awkward|awkward]].

Tony [[approached|approach]] Ted and [[apologized|apologize]]. "I'm sorry about everything," he said. "I never meant to [[hurt|hurt]] you."

Ted was [[skeptical|skeptical]]. But Tony seemed [[genuine|genuine]]. He explained that Stella's [[history|history]] with him was [[complicated|complicate]]. They had been together since high school, broken up, and gotten back together many times.

"She always comes back to me," Tony said [[bitterly|bitter]]. "I don't know why."

Meanwhile, Barney tried to talk his way out of a [[speeding|speed]] ticket. The officer was a woman, and Barney [[attempted|attempt]] every [[charm|charm]] technique he knew. It [[failed|fail]] [[miserably|miserable]].

"You're getting a ticket," the officer said [[firmly|firm]].

Ted and Tony ended up having a long conversation. Tony [[revealed|reveal]] that he and Stella were engaged again. Ted felt a [[pang|pang]] of [[jealousy|jealousy]], but he [[swallowed|swallow]] it.

"I hope she's happy," Ted said.

Tony [[nodded|nod]]. "She is. And I think you'll find someone too. You just have to be [[patient|patient]]."

Ted smiled [[weakly|weak]]. "I've been told."

As Ted left the restaurant, he felt a strange sense of [[closure|closure]]. Maybe letting go was the [[fastest|fast]] way to move forward.

history.en: things that happened in the past between people

bitter.en: in a way that shows sadness and anger

charm.en: the power to please or attract

miserable.en: in a very bad or unsuccessful way

firm.en: in a strong and determined way

jealousy.en: the feeling of wanting what someone else has

nod.en: to move your head up and down

patient.en: able to wait without getting angry

weak.en: in a way that is not strong

closure.en: a feeling that something is finally finished
